record.paper_title: Progress and open questions in the physics of neutrino cross sections at intermediate energies
record.original_question: How can modern theoretical descriptions of neutrino-nucleus interactions, including improved nuclear dynamics, multinucleon excitations, pion production, final-state interactions, and related effects, be implemented consistently and efficiently in Monte Carlo event generators so that precision oscillation analyses are not forced to rely on outdated interaction models?

evidence.quote: Some event generators incorporate rather old theoretical models to simulate neutrino interactions, even though more sophisticate schemes have recently become available.

We should also stress that, to achieve the precision goals in neutrino oscillation measurements and to reliably extract information about the axial properties of the nucleon and baryon resonances, it is crucial that the current theoretical developments are implemented in the event generators used in the experimental data analysis.
The strategy, adopted by some oscillation experiments, of fitting the new data with the parameters available in the MC event generators is dangerous in the long term.

artifact.status_search_result: This is a long-standing community challenge in neutrino physics. Subsequent generator development efforts (NuWro, GENIE, NEUT, GiBUU, ACHILLES) have made substantial progress in implementing 2p2h models (Valencia, SuSAv2), spectral functions, and improved FSI, but a fully consistent and unified implementation across all channels remains an active and open research program, repeatedly emphasized in recent NuSTEC white papers and Snowmass reports.

status_evidence.title: NuSTEC White Paper: Status and challenges of neutrino-nucleus scattering
status_evidence.snippet: Calls for consistent implementation of modern nuclear models in event generators as a major outstanding challenge.
status_evidence.claim: The need for consistent implementation of modern theoretical descriptions in MC generators remains an outstanding challenge.
